prompt:
Create an ORIGINAL unlabeled flat 2D academic mechanism illustration explaining THREE separate LightGBM approximations. Choose an original balanced composition. Attached new external original-paper pages provide mechanism facts, never copy their text or layout. Draw NO letters, digits, pseudo-text, mathematical symbols, formula or watermark. Pure white canvas, fine neutral lines, ample empty title/annotation space, clear concrete mechanism objects, not icon cards. Consistent semantic colors Blue #7B95C6/Cyan #49C2D9/Green #67A583/Orange #F59C7C/Rose #C85E62 with white and very pale uniform 18–25% tints. Constant solid fills, no gradients, grain, waves, textures, clouding, shadow, gloss, 3D or perspective.
(1) HISTOGRAM: continuous feature values as small tokens along a line, group tokens by exactly FOUR bucket boundary intervals, aggregate per-bucket derivative statistics as a four-column histogram or table. Teaching schematic NOT measured data, no invented numeric values.
(2) GOSS: samples split by gradient magnitude. Keep ALL high-absolute-gradient examples (e.g. four large circles), RANDOMLY keep only SOME of remaining low-gradient examples (e.g. select three of nine smaller circles); selected small-gradient samples receive increased contribution weight, shown by an extra simple outline ring or separate rescaling arrow. Unselected low-gradient examples gray faint. Final sample pool includes all four large-gradient samples AND the three weighted sampled low-gradient examples. Weighting must apply only sampled small-gradient group. Not subsampling high-gradient group and not duplicating actual samples.
(3) EFB: EXACTLY THREE sparse feature columns across SIX matching sample rows, each row has at MOST ONE nonzero colored cell across the three columns. Bundle to ONE feature column with separate offsets encoding original feature identity (same six row positions preserved, three hues with different positions or short outlined bin segments). Example source active feature positions per row: row1 feature1, row2 feature2, row3 feature3, row4 feature1, row5 allzero, row6 feature2. Corresponding bundled row5 must still be allzero. Preserve nonzero identity rather than sum colliding simultaneously active values. Show independent panels without edges between them, concise blank label slots.
reference_policy: Only newly selected external original paper; no old project imagery.
